Notes on the ends of the chain:
- The generated client stub on the Go side is `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go:305` (`memoServiceClient.CreateMemo`); the web path uses the TS client in `web/src/connect.ts` instead, with request types from `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts:284`.
- The other dialect drivers implementing the same `store.Driver.CreateMemo` contract are `store/db/postgres/memo.go:16` and `store/db/mysql/memo.go:16`.
- The editor path reaches the same hop via `web/src/components/MemoEditor/services/memoService.ts:120` (`memoServiceClient.createMemo`), so the hook is one of two frontend entry points into the same client call.
